units.source_text: 这时，一个四十开外的汉子打开隔扇，叫姑娘们进去用餐。

en.t: Just then, a man in his forties opened the sliding door and called the girls in to eat.

units.source_text: 他也租了这小客店的一个房间开鸡肉火锅店。

en.t: He, too, had rented a room in the small inn and was running a chicken hot-pot shop there.

units.source_text: 舞女带着筷子同百合子一起到贴邻的小房间吃剩下的火锅。

en.t: The dancing girl took her chopsticks and went with Yuriko to the little room next door to eat the leftover hot pot.

units.source_text: 他们一起返回这边房间的途中，这汉子轻轻地拍了拍舞女的肩膀。

en.t: As they were returning together to this room, the man lightly patted the dancing girl on the shoulder.

units.source_text: 阿妈板起可怕的面孔说：

en.t: The mother put on a frighteningly stern face and said:
